nav.label: Audience research
nav.description: Turn public complaints, requests, and questions into content, product, and SEO opportunities.

competitors.label: Competitors
competitors.helper: Pick up to five competitors already tracked for this site.

topics.label: Topics
topics.placeholder: Add a topic and press Enter
topics.validationLength: Topics must be between 2 and 160 characters.
topics.validationEmpty: Enter a topic before adding it.
topics.validationMax: You can add up to {{max}} topics.

preview.unsupported: This market has limited support — results may be thinner.
preview.coverageDegraded: Degraded provider coverage — results may be partial.
preview.coverageBlocked: Zero-data-retention scraping is blocked for this account.

confirm.title: Start this audience research run?
confirm.body: This run will crawl up to {{maxPages}} public pages and generate signals from the public web. It runs once — there is no continuous monitoring.

partial.title: This run finished with partial coverage
partial.body: Some sources or the AI stage hit a ceiling before finishing. The signals below reflect only the evidence collected before the run stopped.

failed.title: This run failed
failed.body: This run did not finish. Try again, or try a narrower topic or a different competitor.

noUsableEvidence.title: No usable evidence found
noUsableEvidence.body: We could not find enough public evidence to generate signals for this market and topic set. Your run was refunded.

history.title: Run history

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.body: Start your first audience research run to see complaints, requests, and questions from the public web.

history.coverageNote: Partial coverage — open the run for details

locked.title: Audience research is not included in your plan
locked.body: Upgrade to Starter, Pro, or Agency to run voice-of-customer research and turn public feedback into content, product, and SEO opportunities.

audience_research_runs.label: Audience research runs
audience_research_runs.description: One whole voice-of-customer research run per unit, regardless of how many searches or scrapes it makes.

overCap.audience_research_runs: You have used every audience research run on your plan this month. Upgrade to run more voice-of-customer research.

empty.title: This run finished but produced no signals.
empty.filtered: No signals match the current filters.

route.aiInterpretationHint: The suggested route is an AI interpretation of the evidence, not a market share signal.

evidence.title: Signal evidence
evidence.description: Every retained source cited by this signal. Text and links only — no HTML.
evidence.empty: This signal has no retained sources.
evidence.missingSource: Cited source {{id}} is no longer available.
evidence.openLinkAria: Open source ({{host}}) in a new tab

decision.conflict: Another decision was already applied to this signal.
decision.replayHintCi: This signal was already accepted as a Content Intelligence recommendation.
decision.replayHintActions: This signal was already added to Next Actions.

acceptBody.content: This will create a Content Intelligence recommendation from the retained sources cited by this signal.
acceptBody.comparison_page: This will create a Content Intelligence comparison-page recommendation from the retained sources cited by this signal.
acceptBody.product: This will register a product-change action in Next Actions.
acceptBody.seo: This will register an SEO fix in Next Actions.

destination.contentDetail: The Content Intelligence recommendation links back to this signal and only references retained source IDs — no source text is copied.
destination.actionsDetail: The Next Actions entry links back to this signal and reads the immutable retained sources when displayed — no source text is copied.

decision.dismissBody: Pick a reason so we can improve the model. This is terminal — the signal will not reappear.

errors.overCap: You have used every audience research run on your plan this month. Upgrade to run more.
errors.unsupportedMarket: Audience research is not available in that market yet. Try a supported country or language.
errors.zdrBlocked: Audience research needs zero-data-retention scraping. Turn on ZDR in your provider settings and try again.
errors.noUsableEvidence: No usable public evidence was found. Your run was refunded — try a different topic or competitor.
errors.costCeilingPartial: This run reached its cost limit. Partial evidence has been saved; use it or try a narrower topic.
errors.processingFailure: This run could not be processed. Partial evidence has been saved when available.
errors.notFound: That run could not be found.
errors.providerFailed: The research provider could not complete this run. Try again shortly.
errors.aiFailed: The AI clustering step could not complete. Partial evidence has been saved when available.
